newsitem.title: GERMANY: German air passenger market grows 2.6 pct in '96.
newsitem.headline: German air passenger market grows 2.6 pct in '96.

text.p: The German air passenger market grew 2.6 percent to 113.25 million passengers in 1996, the German airports association ADV said.
Growth was lower than in previous years, however, due to difficult economic conditions in Germany, an ADV report said.
Domestic German air travel decreased last year primarily due to a strong fall in the number of commuters flying between western and eastern Germany, the ADV said.
Inland flights carried 34.35 million passengers in 1996, a fall of 1.1 percent on 1995.
Travel to European destinations rose 5.2 percent to 58.18 million, with a 4.2 percent growth in EU travel and 5.7 percent rise to countries within the Schengen zone.
Overseas travel grew 2.4 percent to 18.6 million passengers, the ADV said.
The most popular destinations were Spain, the U.S. and Turkey, it added.
The fastest-growing major German airports were Stuttgart up 26 percent, Cologne up 10 percent and Munich up 5.5 percent. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
